note: Reference baseline — the v2 earningsPredictor component weights (nominal max magnitude per component). The weight tuner (scripts/tune-earnings-weights.mjs) reports MULTIPLIERS relative to these, and this file is the rollback anchor: if a future data-driven weight change underperforms, restore the predictor to these values. The tuner NEVER edits the predictor automatically — a human applies the winning multipliers by hand.
